items.title: Eddie Marshall interviewed by Monk Rowe, San Francisco, California, August 8, 2002
items.q: There’s a couple of groups I play with, one is the Bill Bell Trio.

ctx.x: Do you have any interesting plans in the near future?

Well actually I mean see another thing about this area, you can always re-invent yourself. Now I’ve been teaching a lot this past couple of years so I haven’t really been playing out nights. There’s a couple of groups I play with, one is the Bill Bell Trio. It’s the Eddie Marshall Trio when it’s my job and it’s Bill Bell — and that’s sounding like a straight ahead jazz trio. But I’m trying to put together an organ trio with organ, saxophone and drums. And that will probably be my next adventure. And plus writing…
Are you able to hear things back when you do the computer?
